subject: Renewal evidence cascade & PO acceleration
messages:
From: Sally Chen <sally.chen@heliohealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: 2027-10-19T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal evidence request and PO timing

Hi Jordan,

We're working our renewal queue for the HelioHealth production contracts and procurement asked me to consolidate evidence and a target PO date so they can schedule the release. Can you confirm: 

- A single evidence bundle we can give to procurement (SOC2 report, data retention policy, access matrix, incident response plan)
- Whether Redwood can accept a PO by Nov 2 and start a term increase immediately after PO acceptance
- If there's any special routing required in your procurement portal (they use ServiceNow and request a direct purchase link)

We're aiming to increase committed capacity by ~30% starting Jan 1 and want to avoid legal redlines during signature. Procurement has a hard cutoff on validating evidence on Nov 5 to include in their board packet.

Thanks,
Sally
Sally Chen
Procurement Lead, HelioHealth
procurement@heliohealth.com
[HelioHealth PO Portal: https://procure.heliohealth.com]

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Sally Chen <sally.chen@heliohealth.com>
Cc: procurement@heliohealth.com
Date: 2027-10-20T08:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal evidence request and PO timing

Hi Sally — thanks for the heads up. We can get you what procurement needs and hit the Nov 2 PO target. Plan below: 

1) Evidence bundle: I'll attach a single PDF with SOC 2 attestation excerpt, data retention summary, access matrix, and our incident response checklist. File: Helio_Evidence_Bundle.pdf (attached).

2) PO timing & term change: We can accept a formal PO by Nov 2 and apply the agreed term uplift and capacity increase once the PO is processed by finance. If legal needs the amendment signed first, we can route DocuSign concurrently — procurement can sign the PO and the amendment in parallel to avoid delays.

3) Procurement portal routing: We have a direct purchase link and a ServiceNow-friendly payload. I will create a portal request for you here: https://app.redwood.com/portal/requests/45219 and include a pre-filled purchase form for HelioHealth to attach to ServiceNow.

Next actions:
- I will upload the evidence bundle and share DocuSign link for the amendment today.
- If you need an internal purchase code or a special invoice header, please send the exact fields procurement needs.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com
[Attachment: Helio_Evidence_Bundle.pdf (pdf)]
